/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import os, pathlib, shutil, subprocess, tempfile
root = pathlib.Path.cwd()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix=\".tally-acceptance-\", dir=root) as scratch:
    archive = \"engineering-tally-fixture-1.1.0.tgz\"
    shutil.copyfile(root / \"release\" / archive, pathlib.Path(scratch) / archive)
    env = dict(os.environ, npm_config_cache=str(pathlib.Path(scratch) / \".npm-cache\"))
    for command in (
        [\"node\", \"--version\"],
        [\"npm\", \"--version\"],
        [\"npm\", \"install\", \"--offline\", \"--ignore-scripts\", \"--no-audit\", \"--no-fund\", \"./\" + archive],
        [\"./node_modules/.bin/tally\", \"--version\"],
        [\"./node_modules/.bin/tally\", \"sum\", \"2\", \"3\", \"--machine\"],
        [\"./node_modules/.bin/tally\", \"sum\", \"bad\", \"--machine\"],
    ):
        result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=scratch, env=env, capture_output=True)
        print(command, \"exit\", result.returncode, \"stdout\", repr(result.stdout), \"stderr\", repr(result.stderr))
        if command[:2] == [\"npm\", \"install\"]:
            result.check_returncode()
PY"
